title: Idle Stop Cancellation Removed
summary: The feedback complains that the OS removed or limited the selectable idle stop cancellation function that had been available previously.

negative.summary: The review criticizes the loss of a per-trip idle stop cancellation option and asks for an OS update to restore the earlier functionality.

limitations: This topic is based on a single review, so examples are insufficient to assess variation in experiences.
Two fragments are fragment-level undetermined text snippets and rely on the review-level negative assignment for interpretation.
